news.headline: NeurAxis Earnings Call Signals High Growth, High Hurdles
news.summary: A post-earnings analysis highlighted that while NeurAxis's revenue growth and reimbursement momentum are accelerating, the company still faces rising cash burn and no formal path to profitability guidance, keeping going-concern language in its filings. The piece underscores the tension investors are watching between commercial traction and balance-sheet risk.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Executive and Director Equity Compensation, Enlarges Incentive Plan
news.summary: NeurAxis's Compensation Committee granted large new RSU awards to CEO Brian Carrico and other executives and approved catch-up equity grants to independent directors after a consultant found prior director pay below market, while the board is also seeking shareholder approval to more than double authorized shares under its incentive plan (from about 1.48 million to 3.4 million). The move signals both management retention efforts and a source of potential future share dilution for investors to monitor.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis posted Q2 2026 revenue of $1.9 million (up 116% year-over-year) with gross margin expanding to about 86% as more IB-Stim devices were sold at full reimbursement following the new Category I CPT code, and IB-Stim unit deliveries rose 60% year-over-year; however, net loss widened to $2.1 million and shares fell roughly 7-9% on the print as investors focused on rising cash burn (ending cash of $8.3 million) despite the strong top-line beat. This is the clearest evidence yet that CPT code adoption is translating into real commercial acceleration, but profitability remains distant.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 newly covered lives, extending access to Mid-Atlantic region beneficiaries. This continues the steady drumbeat of payer wins that is directly driving the company's reimbursed-device revenue growth.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 11, 2026 with a same-day conference call, setting up the earnings event that followed. It is a routine scheduling notice but marks the run-up to the quarter's key financial disclosure.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on NeurAxis's 2026 reporting cadence (Q1 on May 12, Q2 on August 11), Q3 2026 results are expected around early-to-mid November 2026. Investors will watch for continued triple-digit revenue growth from the CPT Category I code rollout, gross margin trajectory toward the company's >90% target, and whether cash burn accelerates as guided due to added commercial hiring.

catalysts.label: CY2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule proposed/final rule (CPT 64567 review)
catalysts.detail: CMS typically proposes its next-year Physician Fee Schedule mid-year and finalizes it around November; CPT 64567 (PENFS/IB-Stim) was explicitly exempted from the CY2026 efficiency cut, so the CY2027 rulemaking is a watch item for whether that protection continues or reimbursement rates are adjusted.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) commercial CPT clarity
catalysts.detail: Commercial activity for NeurAxis's adult constipation/evacuation-disorder diagnostic device RED was paused in early 2026 following a CPT coding change; management has said it expects clarity later in 2026 that could allow RED sales and reimbursement to resume, adding a second revenue stream alongside IB-Stim.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS / functional abdominal pain pivotal trial data (Cleveland Clinic and Stanford)
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is running a randomized, double-blind study of PENFS in adult IBS and functional abdominal pain at Cleveland Clinic and Stanford; management has indicated usable data could arrive in roughly one to two years. Positive results would support an FDA submission to expand IB-Stim's label into the estimated $14B combined adult addressable market.

catalysts.label: Target of >200 million covered lives under PENFS reimbursement policies
catalysts.detail: Management has set a goal of exceeding 200 million covered lives under payer medical policies for PENFS by the end of 2027 (versus roughly 100 million-plus as of early-to-mid 2026), driven by continued state and national payer wins following the Category I CPT code. Reaching this scale is central to the company's path toward sustained profitability.

catalysts.label: Path to cash-flow breakeven
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis has flagged going-concern doubt in its filings and has tied a path to cash-flow breakeven to sustained revenue growth, operating leverage, and larger insurance contract wins expected into 2027; there is no formal breakeven guidance date yet, making this a key longer-term milestone to track alongside quarterly cash burn.

pulse: NRXS trades around $6 (roughly $75-80M market cap) as of early September 2026, well off its 52-week high near $9-10, after Q2 2026 results (August 11) showed 116% year-over-year revenue growth and expanding gross margin from the new Category I CPT code for PENFS/IB-Stim, but also a widening net loss and rising cash burn that pushed shares down high-single-digits on the print. The dominant recent thread is the tension between accelerating commercial adoption (500,000+ newly covered lives added August 4, record device deliveries) and balance-sheet/dilution concerns (going-concern language, an enlarged equity incentive plan approved August 13); analysts (e.g., Craig-Hallum) remain bullish with Buy ratings and price targets in the $11-13 range. Near-term watch items are the cash burn trajectory into H2 2026, further payer coverage wins, any RED device commercial resumption, and the next earnings report expected around November 2026.
